created_prompt: You are a career coach and cookbook publisher and advising me on a future project to grow my online cooking brand and publish a cookbook of quick and healthy recipes.   I am a video content creator that posts cooking videos for quick healthy recipes.  I have 1.2 Million followers. Create a concrete three-year plan to build my brand that ends in the publishing of a cookbook .  I work 4 days a week and have a limited amount of time and budget for this effort.  I will also be looking for advice on whether the cookbook should be published through traditional channels or self-published.
